title: Kioxia among eight Japanese companies funding Rapidus launch

sources.quote: The companies – Toyota, Sony, NTT, SoftBank, Kioxia, Denso, NEC and MUFG Bank – have invested a total of 7.3 billion yen (about US$51.5 million) to create the company, the reports said.

explain: Memory maker Kioxia was one of eight Japanese companies that put a combined 7.3 billion yen (about $51.5 million) into Rapidus, the new company trying to bring 2nm chipmaking to Japan. Kioxia's individual share was not disclosed; most Rapidus funding comes from the Japanese government.
